sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: 2003, 17-year-old Brittany Phillips was thrilled when she received a full scholarship to study chemistry at Eckerd College in St. Petersburg,
sentences.zh: 2003年，17岁的布列塔尼·菲利普斯欣喜若狂，因为她获得了全额奖学金，得以进入圣彼得堡的埃克德学院攻读化学专业。

sentences.en: a coastal city in Florida's Tampa Bay region.
sentences.zh: 圣彼得堡是佛罗里达州坦帕湾地区的一座沿海城市。

sentences.en: Her mother, Dr. Maggie Zingman, had attended the same college in the 1970s, and excitedly helped her daughter prepare for the interstate move from their hometown of Tulsa,
sentences.zh: 她的母亲玛吉·辛格曼博士曾在20世纪70年代就读于同一所学院，她兴奋地帮助女儿准备从家乡塔尔萨搬到外州的事宜。

sentences.en: Oklahoma.
sentences.zh: 俄克拉荷马州。

sentences.en: Brittany was inspired to study chemistry after losing her grandmother to cancer during her senior year of high school,
sentences.zh: 布列塔尼在高中最后一年因癌症失去了祖母，这激励她投身化学研究，

sentences.en: and had decided to dedicate her life to finding a cure for the disease.
sentences.zh: 并决定毕生致力于寻找治愈这种疾病的方法。

sentences.en: She left for college in August of 2003, and threw herself wholeheartedly into her studies.
sentences.zh: 2003年8月，她动身前往大学，全身心地投入到学业中。

sentences.en: Brittany was a friendly and trusting young woman who had no problems settling into her new surroundings.
sentences.zh: 布列塔尼是一位友好且容易轻信他人的年轻女性，她很快就适应了新的环境。

sentences.en: She succeeded academically, made new friends, and took a part-time job waitressing at a popular seafood restaurant.
sentences.zh: 她学业有成，结识了新朋友，还在一家受欢迎的海鲜餐厅找了一份兼职服务员的工作。

sentences.en: However, as she neared the end of her first year at Eckerd College, Brittany became increasingly homesick.
sentences.zh: 然而，随着在埃克德学院第一学年接近尾声，布列塔尼开始愈发想家。

sentences.en: She was a year younger than her classmates, having started kindergarten a year ahead of schedule, and she found it difficult to be away from her loved ones.
sentences.zh: 她比同班同学小一岁，因为提前一年上了幼儿园，所以她发现自己很难忍受与亲人分离。

sentences.en: She decided to withdraw from Eckerd College and returned to Tulsa to continue her studies closer to home.
sentences.zh: 她决定从埃克德学院退学，回到塔尔萨，在离家更近的地方继续学业。

sentences.en: Brittany's mother, Maggie, and older brother, Joshua, supported this decision wholeheartedly.
sentences.zh: 布列塔尼的母亲玛吉和哥哥约书亚全力支持这一决定。

sentences.en: They were a close-knit trio, with the mother and daughter speaking on the phone nearly every day.
sentences.zh: 他们是一个关系紧密的三口之家，母女俩几乎每天都会通电话。

sentences.en: Maggie was always Brittany's first point of contact whenever she was struggling or needed advice, and she was relieved that Brittany was returning to the comfort of Tulsa.
sentences.zh: 每当布列塔尼遇到困难或需要建议时，玛吉总是她第一个联系的人，得知布列塔尼要回到舒适的塔尔萨，玛吉感到如释重负。

sentences.en: As a concerned mother, she had been worried about Brittany's safety while she was studying interstate.
sentences.zh: 作为一位忧心忡忡的母亲，她一直担心布列塔尼在外州求学时的安全。

sentences.en: Not only was Brittany younger than her classmates, but she had a particularly youthful appearance and a trusting nature that Maggie feared could make her especially vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 布列塔尼不仅比同学年纪小，而且长相格外稚嫩，性格又容易轻信他人，玛吉担心这会让她变得特别脆弱。

sentences.en: In May 2004, 18-year-old Brittany returned to Oklahoma and enrolled in Tulsa Community College.
sentences.zh: 2004年5月，18岁的布列塔尼回到俄克拉荷马州，并注册入读了塔尔萨社区学院。

sentences.en: Her plan was to obtain the relevant transfer grades that would allow her to study chemistry at Oklahoma State University.
sentences.zh: 她的计划是取得相应的转学成绩，以便日后能进入俄克拉荷马州立大学攻读化学。

sentences.en: After perusing local apartment listings, she found a suitable one-bedroom apartment in a large housing complex called Glen Eagles,
sentences.zh: 在浏览了当地的公寓租赁信息后，她在名为“格伦伊格尔斯”的大型住宅区找到了一间合适的一居室公寓，

sentences.en: which was located at 9407 East 65th Street in Tulsa.
sentences.zh: 该公寓位于塔尔萨东65街9407号。

sentences.en: Glen Eagles housed multiple blocks of one- and two-storey apartment buildings,
sentences.zh: 格伦伊格尔斯拥有多栋一到两层的公寓楼，

sentences.en: interspersed with car parking facilities, and was home to many other students at Tulsa Community College, as well as working couples and young families.
sentences.zh: 楼间穿插着停车场，住着许多塔尔萨社区学院的学生，以及工作的夫妇和年轻家庭。

sentences.en: It was within walking distance of Union High School, where Brittany had graduated from just over a year prior, which pleased her as she was already familiar with the area.
sentences.zh: 公寓距离联合高中仅步行距离，布列塔尼一年多前刚从那里毕业，这让她感到很高兴，因为她对这一带已经很熟悉了。

sentences.en: Brittany and Maggie inspected apartment number 3216 in the 32nd building.
sentences.zh: 布列塔尼和玛吉一起查看了32号楼的3216号公寓。

sentences.en: All up, the building had 16 apartments across two levels, with 8 on the bottom storey and 8 on the top.
sentences.zh: 整栋楼共有16套公寓，分两层，底层8套，顶层8套。

sentences.en: Depending on the location of each apartment, access could be gained via either a front or rear entry.
sentences.zh: 根据公寓位置的不同，可以通过前门或后门进入。

sentences.en: Apartment 3216 was situated on the top floor at the end of the building, meaning there were only adjoining neighbours to one side.
sentences.zh: 3216号公寓位于顶层楼尾，这意味着只有一侧有邻居。

sentences.en: The interior was small and a little dated, but it had everything Brittany would need for life as a busy student, including a kitchen, small dining area, living room, and bathroom.
sentences.zh: 室内空间不大，装修也略显陈旧，但对于忙碌的学生生活来说，这里设施齐全，包括厨房、小餐厅、客厅和浴室。

sentences.en: The bedroom even featured a walk-in wardrobe and floor-to-ceiling bay windows that opened onto a small balcony.
sentences.zh: 卧室甚至配有一个步入式衣橱和落地凸窗，窗外连着一个小阳台。

sentences.en: The front door, which was accessible from the rear of the building, had a small dent in it, but the landlord assured Brittany they would have it repaired,
sentences.zh: 从楼后可以进入的前门上有一个小凹痕，但房东向布列塔尼保证会修好它，

sentences.en: and the rest of the apartment appeared to be in good condition.
sentences.zh: 公寓的其他部分看起来状况良好。

sentences.en: Being a safety-conscious mother, Maggie researched the area online and found that the crime rate there was lower than the state average.
sentences.zh: 作为一名有安全意识的母亲，玛吉在网上调查了该地区，发现那里的犯罪率低于州平均水平。

sentences.en: She also ran a check for sexual predators in the neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 她还查询了该社区是否有性犯罪者。

sentences.en: Concluding that it would be a safe and convenient place to live,
sentences.zh: 在得出这是一个安全且便利的居住地的结论后，

sentences.en: Brittany handed over her deposit and signed the lease.
sentences.zh: 布列塔尼交了押金并签了租约。

sentences.en: Brittany quickly settled back into life in Tulsa.
sentences.zh: 布列塔尼很快重新适应了塔尔萨的生活。

sentences.en: She attended classes at college 16 hours a week and secured a part-time job as a waitress at a nearby Applebee's restaurant.
sentences.zh: 她每周上16小时的大学课程，并在附近的一家Applebee's餐厅找到了一份兼职服务员的工作。

sentences.en: It didn't take long for her to make friends and she soon became close with a group of female students who took turns hosting study groups at their respective homes.
sentences.zh: 她很快就交到了朋友，并与一群女学生变得亲密，她们轮流在各自家中举办学习小组。

sentences.en: Brittany warmly welcomed her friends and their partners to her apartment and enjoyed playing the role of hoSt.
sentences.zh: 布列塔尼热情地欢迎朋友和她们的伴侣来到自己的公寓，并乐于扮演女主人的角色。

sentences.en: Every weekend, she made the two-hour round trip to visit her mother Maggie at her home in the small Oklahoma town of Chandler, where Maggie worked as a psychologist and counsellor
sentences.zh: 每个周末，她都会往返两小时，去俄克拉荷马州钱德勒小镇探望母亲玛吉，玛吉在那里担任心理学家和咨询师，

sentences.en: at a maximum-security women's prison.
sentences.zh: 工作地点是一所最高安全级别的女子监狱。

sentences.en: In Tulsa, Brittany soon began dating.
sentences.zh: 在塔尔萨，布列塔尼很快开始约会。

sentences.en: Ever since she was little, Maggie had nicknamed her
sentences.zh: 玛吉从小就给她起了个绰号，叫

sentences.en: Pretty Britty on account of her long curly blonde hair, wide eyes and infectious, dimpled smile.
sentences.zh: “漂亮布列塔尼”，因为她有一头卷曲的长金发、大眼睛，还有那充满感染力、带着酒窝的笑容。

sentences.en: She was five foot two inches tall with a petite frame and fresh face and her natural beauty had landed her some occasional modelling work.
sentences.zh: 她身高五英尺二英寸，身材娇小，面容清秀，天生丽质的她偶尔还会接一些模特工作。

sentences.en: The combination of her good looks and kind nature ensured Brittany was never short of admirers.
sentences.zh: 出众的外貌和善良的本性，让布列塔尼从不缺乏追求者。

sentences.en: As she was the type of person who didn't like turning anyone down,
sentences.zh: 由于她是不喜欢拒绝任何人的那种人，

sentences.en: Brittany attracted a fair share of undesirable boyfriends, some of whom were physically and verbally abusive towards her.
sentences.zh: 布列塔尼吸引了不少糟糕的男友，其中一些人对她有身体和言语上的虐待。

sentences.en: At one stage, she went on a date with a security guard who she described to her mother as creepy and strange.
sentences.zh: 有一次，她和一个保安约会，她向母亲形容那个男人令人毛骨悚然且古怪。

sentences.en: Despite saying she didn't want to see him again, the security guard continued pursuing Brittany until she eventually had to block his number.
sentences.zh: 尽管她说不想再见到他，但那个保安一直纠缠布列塔尼，直到她最终不得不拉黑了他的号码。

sentences.en: Maggie was relieved when Brittany started dating a nice young man whom she brought to Chandler for a visit.
sentences.zh: 当布列塔尼开始和一个她带回钱德勒探望过的不错的小伙子约会时，玛吉感到很欣慰。

sentences.en: On the afternoon of Monday, September 27, 2004,
sentences.zh: 2004年9月27日，星期一的下午，

sentences.en: Brittany was suffering from seasonal allergies that caused her to feel unwell and irritable.
sentences.zh: 布列塔尼患上了季节性过敏，这让她感到身体不适且烦躁不安。

sentences.en: This was an ongoing health issue and she went to the urgent care medical centre where she sat in the waiting room for several hours before leaving without seeing a doctor.
sentences.zh: 这是一个持续性的健康问题，她去了急诊医疗中心，在候诊室坐了几个小时，最后没看医生就离开了。

sentences.en: Frustrated, she called her mother for advice.
sentences.zh: 感到沮丧的她打电话向母亲寻求建议。

sentences.en: Maggie told her not to worry and that she would book an appointment for Brittany to see a doctor in Chandler when she came to visit on the weekend.
sentences.zh: 玛吉告诉她不要担心，并说等周末她来探望时，会帮布列塔尼预约钱德勒的医生。

sentences.en: Brittany agreed, telling her mother she had an evening class to attend and would then go straight home to bed.
sentences.zh: 布列塔尼同意了，告诉母亲她晚上还有一节课，下课后就直接回家睡觉。

sentences.en: The pair ended the call as they always did, telling each other,
sentences.zh: 两人像往常一样结束了通话，互道：

sentences.en: I love you.
sentences.zh: “我爱你。”

sentences.en: Brittany then drove to pick up a friend for their class at Tulsa Community College's South Campus.
sentences.zh: 随后，布列塔尼开车去接一位朋友，前往塔尔萨社区学院南校区上课。

sentences.en: On the way into the class, she ran into her brother Joshua, who was also studying at the campus, and the two had a brief conversation.
sentences.zh: 在去教室的路上，她遇到了同样在该校区学习的哥哥约书亚，两人进行了简短的交谈。

sentences.en: After class, at approximately 9.45pm,
sentences.zh: 下课后，大约晚上9点45分，

sentences.en: Brittany dropped her friend home and then drove the short distance back to her apartment.
sentences.zh: 布列塔尼把朋友送回家，然后开车回到了自己的公寓。

sentences.en: The next day of Tuesday, September 28,
sentences.zh: 第二天，9月28日，星期二，

sentences.en: Brittany didn't show up to her scheduled classes.
sentences.zh: 布列塔尼没有出现在预定的课堂上。

sentences.en: Her friends noted this as highly unusual as she was a dedicated and punctual student, but they assumed she must still be feeling unwell.
sentences.zh: 她的朋友们觉得这非常反常，因为她是一个专注且守时的学生，但她们认为她可能还在生病。

sentences.en: That same day,
sentences.zh: 同一天，

sentences.en: Maggie tried to call Brittany, but her phone rang out and eventually went to voicemail.
sentences.zh: 玛吉试图给布列塔尼打电话，但电话一直响，最终转入了语音信箱。

sentences.en: Maggie left a message asking her daughter to return her call.
sentences.zh: 玛吉留了言，让女儿回电。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, September 29,
sentences.zh: 9月29日，星期三，

sentences.en: Brittany was once again absent from her classes and still hadn't returned Maggie's call.
sentences.zh: 布列塔尼再次缺席了课程，也依然没有回玛吉的电话。

sentences.en: Maggie phoned again and left another voicemail.
sentences.zh: 玛吉再次拨打电话，又留了一条语音留言。

sentences.en: Although it was unusual for the mother and daughter to go a few days without speaking, it did occasionally happen, so Maggie tried to reassure herself
sentences.zh: 虽然母女俩几天不说话是不寻常的，但偶尔也会发生，所以玛吉试图让自己放心，

sentences.en: that Brittany was likely just busy and would return the call in due course.
sentences.zh: 认为布列塔尼可能只是太忙了，过会儿就会回电。

sentences.en: When Brittany still hadn't shown up to any of her classes by Thursday, September 30, her friends began to worry.
sentences.zh: 到了9月30日，星期四，布列塔尼依然没有出现在任何课堂上，她的朋友们开始担心起来。

sentences.en: At 9pm that evening,
sentences.zh: 当晚9点，

sentences.en: Maggie called Brittany, but for the third time in as many days, the call went unanswered.
sentences.zh: 玛吉给布列塔尼打电话，但这是三天内第三次无人接听。

sentences.en: She left a third voicemail, this time asking Brittany to call her back immediately as she was starting to become very concerned.
sentences.zh: 她留下了第三条语音留言，这次她要求布列塔尼立即回电，因为她开始感到非常不安。

sentences.en: Brittany's friend, Emma, not her real name, decided to check on Brittany herself.
sentences.zh: 布列塔尼的朋友艾玛（化名）决定亲自去看看布列塔尼。

sentences.en: Emma's father was a district attorney with a background as a police officer, so she called him as she made her way up the stairs to Brittany's apartment
sentences.zh: 艾玛的父亲是一位曾担任警官的地区检察官，所以她在走上楼梯前往布列塔尼公寓的途中给他打了电话，

sentences.en: and explained the situation.
sentences.zh: 并说明了情况。

sentences.en: When Emma reached the front door, she knocked, but there was no response.
sentences.zh: 当艾玛到达前门时，她敲了敲门，但无人应答。

sentences.en: She tried the door handle and was surprised to find that it was unlocked.
sentences.zh: 她试了试门把手，惊讶地发现门没锁。

sentences.en: She pushed it open a crack, but her father, who was still on the phone, warned her against going inside.
sentences.zh: 她把门推开了一条缝，但仍在通话中的父亲警告她不要进去。

sentences.en: Instead, he offered to send a police officer around to perform a wellness check.
sentences.zh: 相反，他提出派一名警官过去进行健康检查。

sentences.en: The dispatch officers arrived at the apartment just before 10pm.
sentences.zh: 调度警官在晚上10点前赶到了公寓。

sentences.en: Inside the bedroom, alongside the bed, they found Brittany's lifeless body lying on the floor, facing away from the bedhead.
sentences.zh: 在卧室床边，他们发现了布列塔尼毫无生气的遗体，她脸朝下躺在地板上，背对着床头。

sentences.en: It was immediately obvious that her death was the result of a homicide, with marks on her neck indicating she had been strangled.
sentences.zh: 很明显，这是一起他杀案件，她脖子上的痕迹表明她是被勒死的。

sentences.en: She was wearing a sleeveless top and underwear, but it appeared as though she may have been redressed into this outfit.
sentences.zh: 她穿着一件无袖上衣和内衣，但看起来她似乎是被重新穿上了这套衣服。

sentences.en: Investigators were dispatched to the apartment while a crime scene was quickly established and Brittany's body was transported to the medical examiner's office
sentences.zh: 调查人员被派往公寓，犯罪现场迅速被封锁，布列塔尼的遗体被送往法医办公室，

sentences.en: for further investigation.
sentences.zh: 以进行进一步调查。

sentences.en: In the early morning hours of Friday October 1, an officer from the
sentences.zh: 10月1日，星期五凌晨，来自

sentences.en: Chandler County Sheriff's Department was sent to Maggie's home to deliver the news.
sentences.zh: 钱德勒县治安官办公室的一名警官被派往玛吉家传达这一消息。

sentences.en: When she opened to the door, the officer told her bluntly,
sentences.zh: 当她打开门时，警官直截了当地告诉她：

sentences.en: You need to call the Tulsa police.
sentences.zh: “你需要给塔尔萨警方打电话。”

sentences.en: Your daughter has been murdered.
sentences.zh: “你的女儿被谋杀了。”

sentences.en: Assuming the authorities must have Brittany confused with someone else,
sentences.zh: 玛吉以为当局一定是把布列塔尼和别人搞混了，

sentences.en: Maggie got straight into her car and drove the 65 miles southeast to Tulsa.
sentences.zh: 于是直接开车前往65英里外的塔尔萨。

sentences.en: When she arrived at the Glen Eagles complex, she found Brittany's apartment filled with police officers.
sentences.zh: 当她到达格伦伊格尔斯公寓区时，发现布列塔尼的公寓里挤满了警察。

sentences.en: An officer advised that Brittany was deceased and had been identified using the photo on her driver's license.
sentences.zh: 一名警官告知布列塔尼已经去世，并通过她驾照上的照片确认了身份。

sentences.en: Devastated and in shock,
sentences.zh: 悲痛欲绝且处于震惊中的玛吉，

sentences.en: Maggie left for the medical examiner's office in the hope of being able to see her daughter one last time.
sentences.zh: 离开了现场前往法医办公室，希望能最后再看女儿一眼。

sentences.en: Tulsa homicide detective
sentences.zh: 塔尔萨凶杀案侦探

sentences.en: Jeff Felton and a team of local officers were assigned to Brittany's case.
